narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed across Graham and Cochise counties and moved west to southwest into the evening hours. Storms produced heavy rain and flash flooding near Willcox, Benson and St. David.
ev: One to three inches of rain in 2 hours caused flash flooding of roadways south and east of the Willcox Playa. One person was rescued from their vehicle after being stalled in flood waters on North Cochise Stronghold Rd.
One inch of rain in 30 minutes caused flash flooding of Highway 191 about 15 miles south of Safford.
Over an inch of rain in an hour caused flash flooding of roadways in Benson and State Route 80 in St. David. In Benson, one house and the community center were flooded.
